status: Complete preview; technical checks complete, listener review and production approval pending.

picture.mode: One original source-frame draw, one deliberate crop, one uniform scale.
picture.sourceKind: Static forest photograph held in the complete original recording.
picture.sourceReference: The complete original image is available in the muted Source reference control.

visualizer.role: A compact supporting graphic beneath the lyrics. The source forest stays visually steady.
visualizer.shape: 24 separate single-sided straight bars on one fixed baseline. Square ends, muted ivory cores and a tiny local dark shadow.
visualizer.measurement: 24 logarithmic bands from 40 to 10000 Hz, measured on the exact original mix at 50 observations per second. No extra or mirrored frequency channels.

motion.interpolation: Adjacent 50 Hz observations interpolate on the original source clock.

visualizer.ending: 400 ms entrance and 1.72-second closing fade; silent input has zero opacity.
visualizer.pictureTreatment: No reactive foliage exposure, branch contour, emitted glow or autonomous decorative movement. Reading exposure is neutral and feathered.
visualizer.precisionLimit: The 92.88 ms FFT window is centered. Display smoothing and 50 Hz interpolation are artistic controls, not exact physical transient or phoneme measurements. Lyric events are separate and unchanged.
visualizer.seeking: Precomputed source-time history gives the same pose on direct seeking and uninterrupted playback.
visualizer.verification: Actual spectrum-region activity and time variation in both formats, fixed width and baseline, complete glyph clearance, unchanged figure pixels and exact original-crop equality with effects disabled.

type.license: Bundled official Google Fonts font and OFL license.
type.languages: Equal Russian/English weight, size, resting color, focus color and contrast. Stable words receive color-only focus.
type.geometry: Complete-cue reservation protects all duet entrances, exits and held readings. Portrait countervoice above the figure; lead below. Wide voices occupy separate clearing blocks.

timing: V3 rebuilt acoustic decisions retained unchanged: 267 source events, 338 English tokens, 46 display cues. Complete meaning anchors and separate neutral holds share the original 44.1 kHz song clock.
